closes.text: FIXED (BREAKING). The cause was narrower than the item's reading: the per-file trait-scope rule (B515/B535) already held per file but only ever asked TRAIT members - an INHERENT block written outside its type's module (std::display's `impl List<T: Display> { fun join }`) was never asked, so its methods resolved wherever its file had been LOADED, and loading is program-wide. Now the same per-file rule covers such blocks: a file reaches one through a name it binds, any import whose path runs through the block's file (visibility.md §3.2), a selector-only import, or the prelude. Not asked (exemptions): a block in its type's own module or in the module of one of the type's argument types (the `[derive(Store)]` shape); a block in a std module every program loads (compare.vl's `contains` - else every `list.contains` would need an import no build can lack); a block in the ENTRY file (B553's ruled feature). A full build now gives B688's own message (ledger row NEW; B535's stable code + quick-fix data), not the narrow build's steer. Also fixed on the way: the trait-scope rule ignored an import written inside a function body.
